<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="314" y1="18" x2="314" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="18" x2="319" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="18" x2="324" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="13" x2="353" y2="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="7" width="23" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="9" width="17" height="9" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="387" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,61 23,68 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="68" x2="42" y2="68" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Travel setup</text>
    <text x="365" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">1 of 3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="99" width="342" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="99" width="114" height="10" rx="64" fill="#58CC02"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro conversational card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="128" width="352" height="94" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.32"/>
    <rect x="19" y="126" width="352" height="94" rx="14" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="158" r="22" fill="#58CC02"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="154" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="154" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="166" x2="60" y2="166" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="88" y="153" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Let’s personalize your</text>
    <text x="88" y="176" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French lessons for your trip.</text>
    <text x="88" y="199" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">A few quick questions to get started.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Previous conversation -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="254" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">YOUR TRAVEL PLAN</text>
    <rect x="74" y="267" width="292" height="45" rx="14" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <text x="92" y="295" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#15451F">I’m planning a trip to France.</text>
    <circle cx="45" cy="289" r="18" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="45" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Current question -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="43" cy="354" r="18" fill="#58CC02"/>
    <circle cx="37" cy="350" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="350" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="359" x2="50" y2="359" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="74" y="350" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you headed?</text>
    <text x="74" y="377" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Tell us your destination and we’ll tailor</text>
    <text x="74" y="399" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">lessons to the places you’ll visit.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Selected language / French flag -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="423" width="342" height="83" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.3"/>
    <rect x="24" y="421" width="342" height="83" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="436" width="71" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="43" y="437" width="23" height="52" rx="8" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="66" y="437" width="23" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="89" y="437" width="23" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="132" y="453" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">LEARNING</text>
    <text x="132" y="478" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French</text>
    <polyline points="338,457 345,464 338,471" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="541" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
    <rect x="24" y="552" width="342" height="56" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="43" y="587" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">City, region, or country</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="596" x2="347" y2="596" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="579" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="586" x2="353" y2="592" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="24" y="631" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">For example: Paris, Lyon, or the French Riviera</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful destination chips -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="674" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">POPULAR DESTINATIONS</text>
    <rect x="24" y="687" width="82" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="65" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Paris</text>
    <rect x="114" y="687" width="82" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="155" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Nice</text>
    <rect x="204" y="687" width="86" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="247" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Bordeaux</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Disabled continue and skip -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="733" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="763" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Skip for now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="818" width="390" height="26" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="818" x2="390" y2="818" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,826 48,819 57,826 57,835 50,835 50,829 46,829 46,835 39,835" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="48" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="145" cy="827" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="145" y1="821" x2="145" y2="833" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="139" y1="827" x2="151" y2="827" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="145" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="243" cy="827" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="243,820 245,825 251,825 246,829 248,835 243,831 238,835 240,829 235,825 241,825" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="243" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="337" cy="824" r="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="835" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="337" y="843" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
